entities.name: Ravnica: City of Guilds
entities.description: The first novel of the Ravnica Cycle, about the end of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A Boros investigator who investigates crimes and ultimately arrests Szadek.

entities.name: Bell Borca
entities.description: Kos's partner and deputy, killed in a bombing and later a ghost.

entities.name: Fonn
entities.description: Protector of Saint Bayul who disappears after a blast and later saves her mount with Bayul's stone.

entities.name: Saint Bayul
entities.description: A saint entering the City of Ravnica for the Decamillennial, killed in a bombing; his forehead gem is sought by Savra.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A Golgari figure who gives her brother Jarad a mission and seeks to join the Selesnya conclave.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Savra's brother, who saves Fonn and ultimately gains control of the Lupul with Savra's staff.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: A vampire who snaps Savra's neck, announces the end of the Guildpact, and is arrested by Kos.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: A figure Savra and Szadek speak of finding to overthrow the Gorgon leadership.

entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: The three Gorgon leaders, two of whom Savra planned to kill.

entities.name: Myczil Zunich
entities.description: A ghost who leads Kos to witness the bombing attack.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: An ally who returns to help Kos.

entities.name: Pivlic
entities.description: An Orzhov friend of Kos with an arena restaurant.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild whose quietmen attack the arena; Savra seeks to join it.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild whose headquarters is attacked by the Golgari.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A guild that attacks the Boros Legion, starting war.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A guild whose Lupul worms attack.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Selesnya city-tree, corrupted by Savra.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact binding Ravnica's guilds, whose end Szadek announces.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane of guilds.

events.summary: Kos and Borca investigate crimes; Fonn protects Saint Bayul entering the City of Ravnica for the Decamillennial.
events.quote: Agrus Kos and his partner/deputy Bell Borca investigate some crimes and show off the world.

events.summary: Savra gives Jarad a mission and speaks with Szadek about finding Svogthir and overthrowing the Gorgon leadership.
events.quote: Savra meets her brother Jarad and gives him a mission

events.summary: A bombing attack at a restaurant kills Borca and Saint Bayul, and Fonn disappears; Kos wakes in a hospital.
events.quote: Borca and Saint Bayul are killed, and Kos wakes up in a hospital and is informed of Fonn's disappearance.

events.summary: Three days later Fonn wakes with Jarad, who says he was hired to save her; harpies sent by Savra attack them.
events.quote: Savra had sent them to kill them both

events.summary: Borca's ghost tells Kos he must avenge him; Kos and Feather find Fonn and Jarad at Pivlic's arena restaurant and ally against attacking Selesnya quietmen.
events.quote: they form an alliance when Selesnya quietmen attack the arena

events.summary: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion's headquarters, starting a war; Dimir Lupul worms attack.
events.quote: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion ’s headquarters, and it's war.

events.summary: Fonn hears Bayul's last words and learns Savra wanted his forehead gem to join the Selesnya conclave.
events.quote: Fonn hears Saint Bayul's last words

events.summary: Savra places Bayul's stone on her forehead to join the conclave, and Szadek snaps her neck.
Szadek announces the end of the Guildpact; Jarad gains control of the Lupul and Fonn saves her mount with Bayul's stone.
events.quote: Szadek announces the end of the Guildpact

events.summary: Kos arrests Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact.
events.quote: The battle ends with Kos arresting Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact.

relations.note: sent harpies to kill her and Jarad
relations.quote: Savra had sent them to kill them both
